snippet.title: BREAK THROUGH THE SHARDS | FragPunk PC Global Launch Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Rules? They’re just suggestions.

The way may flow, but here—we carve our own path. 
When the hunt is on, she lets the cards decide.

💥#fragpunk PC Global Launch—March 6💥
Step into the chaos—FREE TO PLAY! 🎮🃏🔥

CAST
Directed by: Zitong Lei, Junle Chang
Produced by: WuLiFang, Moge Studio, RockHold-Spiritart Studio
Production Support: Original Force-Noise Studio, Zebra Animation, DingYan, TABLE, ZaiJianNiao
Music Supervision: Shuhao Zhang/Ray Force, Zitong Lei
Composed by: 2wei（Marcel Neumann & Simon Heeger）
Sound & Mix: Yufeng Zhang/Ray Force、Yumeng Song/Ray Force、Haoqiu Huang/Ray Force

Pre-order now! 👇
💣 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407330/FragPunk_Pioneer_Bundle/?beta=0
💣 Epic Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/fragpunk-fragpunk-pioneer-bundle-bae51c
